tagline: Portable autonomous coding + comms agent. Single .exe, zero install.

stack.llm: anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go — OpenAI-compatible wrapper, supports Claude/GPT/Gemini/Ollama via configurable BaseURL

stack_decisions.why_not_goclaw: application framework — all packages are internal/, not importable as library
stack_decisions.llm_client: thin HTTP wrapper over /v1/messages — OpenAI-compatible format, no provider lock-in; BaseURL swappable per config

sandbox.install: downloaded on first boot via golovebox init, not embedded
sandbox.vm_image: Alpine Linux minimal with dev toolchain
sandbox.why_not_wasmedge: WASM only — cant run arbitrary code like git, gcc, npm

steps: interactive config: LLM provider, API keys, GitHub token, Telegram token
smoke test: boot VM, ssh echo ok, print ready

agent_loop.flow: prompt → LLM → parse action → execute tool → observe → repeat
agent_loop.llm_interface: OpenAI-compatible — Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama all supported via BaseURL config

v0_phases.name: Portable Foundation
v0_phases.goal: portable .exe that installs QEMU, boots VM, runs shell
v0_phases.smoke_test: golovebox init installs everything; golovebox run 'echo hello' executes in VM

v0_phases.name: Gateway
v0_phases.smoke_test: Telegram message → PR opened → link replied in Telegram

v0_phases.name: Polish
v0_phases.goal: usable by real human on Windows
v0_phases.smoke_test: README quickstart works end-to-end on fresh Windows machine

v0_done_definition: Copy golovebox.exe to any folder on any Windows drive, run golovebox init, then send a GitHub issue via Telegram, have it cloned in an isolated Alpine VM, implemented, tested, PR opened, and link replied in Telegram — without installing anything on the system beyond what init downloads into the folder.

risks.risk: QEMU installer may not support portable mode without admin
risks.mitigation: test early; fallback: extract official .zip to .golovebox/qemu/

risks.risk: Windows Defender flags QEMU child process
risks.mitigation: official signed installer; document if occurs
CI with CGO_ENABLED=0 that fails the build
